completeRequiredFields: Complete the required automation fields before saving.
couldNotRefreshRuns: Could not refresh runs — restored from local cache
deleteAllRunsDescription: This will permanently remove all run records for this automation — including any not currently loaded — and their associated tasks. This cannot be undone.
executionModeTask: Task — creates a tracked kanban task
invalidExpression: Invalid expression. Use {{every}} with a duration, a shorthand, or a 5-field cron.
listDescription: Create rules that automatically trigger agent tasks.
nameHelp: Enter an automation name to enable saving.
noRepositoriesHelp: With no repositories selected, this automation runs against the workspace's first repository.
noWorkspacesDescription: Create a workspace first, then schedule automations inside it.
pickWorkspace: Pick a workspace to manage its automations.
prEventOpenedTooltip: Fires once when a new open PR is detected. Each PR number is deduped — the same PR won't trigger again.
prTriggerRepositoryHelp: PR triggers always use the PR's own repository.
pushTriggerHelp: Triggers when code is pushed to matching branches
samplePayloadHelp: Paste an example JSON body to discover available placeholders.
scheduleSyntaxHelp: Use <0>{{every}}</0> with a duration (e.g., <1>{{example1}}</1>, <2>{{example2}}</2>) or shorthands like <3>{{hourly}}</3>, <4>{{daily}}</4>, <5>{{weekly}}</5>.
scheduleTooltip: How often to check for matching events. Checked every 30 seconds by a background process. Schedules persist across backend restarts.
taskTitleHelp: Leave empty to use the default. Supports placeholders.
thenDescription: A new task will be created each time this automation triggers
triggerInfoGithubPr: Polls GitHub API on your schedule for PRs matching your filters.
triggerInfoScheduled: Checked every 30 seconds. Fires when the cron schedule matches.
triggerInfoWebhook: Fires immediately when a POST request hits the webhook URL.
webhookCreatedDescription: Configure your external system to POST to this URL with the secret in the <0>{{header}}</0> header. You can come back to this automation any time to copy these values again.
webhookUrlAfterSave: Webhook URL will be available after saving the automation.
webhookUsageHelp: Send a POST request with a JSON body and the secret in the <0>{{header}}</0> header. Reference fields from the payload with <1>{{placeholder}}</1>, e.g. <2>{{example}}</2>.
whenDescription: What causes this automation to run
workflowHelp: Select a workflow to enable saving.
workflowStepHelp: Select a workflow step to enable saving.
workflowStepHelpNoWorkflow: Select a workflow before choosing a step.
